name: Heartwood Pistonguard
prompt: Single monster full-body FRONT orthographic reference for Elyndra fantasy MMORPG. Heartwood Pistonguard: a squat brass guardian with pistons for arms, its body cased in polished heartwood, steam and spores venting from its back. Beautiful hand-painted stylized RPG asset, warm detailed wood grain and aged golden brass, chunky compact mechanical silhouette. Two piston arms with clearly visible telescoping brass cylinders and solid fists, two short sturdy articulated legs, broad polished reddish heartwood chest armor and small recessed mechanical face. Back exhaust vents visible above shoulders; only tiny attached wisps, future animated steam and spores will be separate VFX. Neutral stance facing camera squarely, eye-level no overhead or three-quarter angle. All limbs, feet and vents fully in frame, large clear margins. True transparent background, no haze background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no props, no other characters. Painted dimensional forms with clear dark separation at joints, useful as master for consistent turnaround and animation.
